title: Brian Gutekunst: Micah Parsons' rehab going as expected

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Gutekunst: Micah Parsons' rehab going as expected
sources.description: It isn't an overstatement to say the Packers' promising season ended with Micah Parsons' torn ACL after 40 defensive snaps into the Week 15 game against the Broncos.
